next.reason: 1985: "If numeric, must be unsigned integers and must have a value within the range of one through the maximum number of characters"; 2023: "The number of characters specified shall not exceed the number of characters in the native alphanumeric character set or". 2023 keeps the CLASS literal rules (unsigned integer in range, one-character THROUGH literals) but adds a cap on total characters specified, refusing programs 1985 accepted.
